text_block_list.text:
The climax of spring, the Takarazuka 
Kinen. At last, the day had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —Let's go, Trainer! To the paddock!

Mejiro Ryan holds no doubts in her heart 
as she sets her sights on conquering both 
of this year's Grand Prix races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's the exact same situation as the 
Spring Tenno Sho, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"The stage is Kyoto. Leading the pack are 
you and me――the Mejiro family's two guests 
of honor."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There is just one major difference from 
the Tenno Sho, however.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Just one? Um, well, that's...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...The distance? Last time was 3,200m, 
but today is 2,200m."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, that is not it. There is a much bigger 
difference than that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That would be—your infuriatingly star-like 
face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...You know your own star, and have 
trained in a manner worthy of that star, 
haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I can't believe in myself, so... 
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I trained until I could believe in myself! 
Together with Trainer-san, until we were 
completely satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Not believing in myself would mean not 
believing in the fans who chose me, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Proper effort bears fruit. For the sake of 
the people who taught me that--

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Today—I want to win! Not just against you, 
but this entire race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, rest assured. If you can beat me, 
you'll surely be able to win this race as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to show you. That for a perfected 
Mejiro—there is no such thing as a 
distance barrier.

Hunter or hunted. The first half of the 
Grand Prix, with Mejiro Ryan's dreams on 
the line, begins.
